ADMIN_TAB_SCREEN_DESC: What players see while the game loads: your server's name from the General settings, a background and tips.
ADMIN_C_LOOK_DESC: The server name, subtitle and tagline come from ai-core's General settings.
ADMIN_H_BACKGROUND: The picture behind the loading screen.
ADMIN_C_TIPS_DESC: Short lines shown one after another while players wait.
ADMIN_P_TIP: Jobs pay only while you are on duty.
ADMIN_H_TIP_SECONDS: Seconds each tip stays before the next one.
